section.houseRulesSubtitle: You’ll be staying in someone’s home, so please treat it with care and respect.

html.htmlText:
Non crawling infants are fine to bring. The room is not baby proofed. We have pack and play if you need one. Please let us know in advance of your stay.
We do not accept pets of any kind and please do not allow our dogs in the room.  Please no smoking of any kind. 

Please empty the trash when you check out.  Large trash cans are located in breezeway.

Don’t leave shoes outside the door.
